api_findings: Session has no direct recv API: public poll/3 accepts event count1..128, paused MapSet and max_read_batches1..128; each poll work has aggregate16384-byte read budget. Read is bounded by min(max_frame, remaining work bytes). Receive polling must retain returned advanced Session.

Public Transport.Quic.read/3 delegates to Quic.read/3; caller consumer set on connect is stable connection consumer. Manual Streams.consume replenishes stream+connection credit and Scheduler.consume_stream queues MAX_STREAM_DATA/MAX_DATA. No separate Session ACK/credit grant API exists; application ACK is consumer scheduling before next poll.

Session.send_data accepts application DATA up to16384bytes; data_steps encodes DATA then chunks at max_frame(default16384, public range1..16384). Streams.send requires whole-binary residual stream and connection credit. resume retries frozen blocked fragment; no residual-credit query or pending-rechunk Session API exists. #105 remains applicable to defaultfragment; supported8192configuration is not newly fixed release behavior.

Session.cancel sends RESET_STREAM+STOP_SENDING0x10c and retires request; Session.close begins close then cleanup, returning :ok on completed close. Session.abort clears pending work, retains abandoned operation identity, closes/cleans transport without replay and returns advanced cleared Session.

Transport.Quic close does not stop a borrowed endpoint; cleanup is no-op for endpoint_owned?false. Explicit public stop_endpoint/1 handles retained Endpoint descriptor or PID and requires separate DOWN/rebind proof. Borrowed unresolved connect abort returns :unresolved_shared_connect; guardian retains independent endpoint stop path.
